sentences.text: No: the loan is a floating-rate term loan to an individual for a non-business purpose, sanctioned on 10 February 2026, and the applicable RBI finding says prepayment charge is not permitted for that case.
Clause 9.3 requires a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment, so it is inconsistent with the applicable RBI finding.
The older RBI pre-payment directions for floating rate term loans were superseded and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.

The question does not provide any other RBI pre-payment rule that would permit this charge for this loan type, and the evidence searched shows the UCB rule only permits prepayment charges subject to the stated conditions while the specific condition here says they are not permitted.
